name: lcs-dominican
description: LCS.Dominican — unified AI audiovisual creation platform (Phase 0 + free creator)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @lcs/api" "npm run dev -w @lcs/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lcs/shared && npm run build -w @lcs/web
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @lcs/shared && npm run build -w @lcs/api && npm run build -w @lcs/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @lcs/shared && npm run build -w @lcs/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @lcs/shared && npm run build -w @lcs/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @lcs/web && npm run lint -w @lcs/api
